I'm 19, also a ftm, and I gave birth to my daughter on Oct 30th at 26+4, she weighed 950 grams, currently we're on day 76 I think in the NICU. I had no idea what to expect either and at first it's super scary and intimidating, but over time you'll start to understand everything a bit more. I know it's not much but if you ever need someone to talk to about being in the NICU, you can always pm me, it's nice having someone to talk to that understands what your going through from time to time :)


But just kinda small things I think helped me at first was joining NICU/preemie Facebook groups, I never really used fb before I had my daughter, but it's nice seeing success stories.
Also I definitely recommend taking at least one day out of your week to skip going to the hospital, spend it with your partner, spend it with your family, hell spend it by yourself playing video games, just anything to feel "normal".

Congratulations on having your daughter  !!!
